body:
## Pull request overview

Adds convention-based i18n resolution for object/field labels (Salesforce-style) so existing CRM translation bundles are used without converting metadata labels to explicit `I18nLabel` objects, and fixes initial app-specific translation loading in the i18n provider.

**Changes:**
- Introduces `useObjectLabel()` hook in `@object-ui/i18n` to auto-resolve `crm.objects.*` / `crm.fields.*` keys with plain-string fallbacks.
- Wires object/field label resolution into Console views (ObjectView, sidebar navigation) and widget header paths (ObjectGrid, ListView).
- Updates `I18nProvider` to load app translations on mount and track loaded app languages separately from built-in locales; adds unit tests for `useObjectLabel`.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 13 out of 13 changed files in this pull request and generated 5 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/react/src/index.ts | Re-exports `useObjectLabel` from `@object-ui/i18n` via `@object-ui/react`. |
| packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx | Resolves toolbar/field labels via convention-based `fieldLabel`. |
| packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx | Resolves column headers via convention-based `fieldLabel` across all column-definition paths. |
| packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx | Adds optional `resolveObjectLabel` callback for object-type nav items with string labels. |
| packages/i18n/src/useObjectLabel.ts | New hook implementing convention-based object/field label lookup with fallbacks. |
| packages/i18n/src/provider.tsx | Fixes app translation loading on mount + avoids `hasResourceBundle` false positives via `loadedAppLangs`. |
| packages/i18n/src/index.ts | Exports `useObjectLabel` from the i18n package. |
| packages/i18n/src/__tests__/useObjectLabel.test.tsx | Adds unit tests covering translation hit/fallback behavior for the new hook. |
| apps/console/src/components/ObjectView.tsx | Uses `objectLabel` / `objectDescription` for breadcrumb/title/description/drawer title. |
| apps/console/src/components/AppSidebar.tsx | Passes object label resolver into `NavigationRenderer`. |
| apps/console/src/__tests__/app-creation-integration.test.tsx | Extends `@object-ui/i18n` mock to include `useObjectLabel`. |
| apps/console/src/__tests__/AppSidebar.test.tsx | Extends `@object-ui/i18n` mock to include `useObjectLabel`. |
| ROADMAP.md | Documents completion of the i18n auto-resolution feature. |
</details>

The new “initial load on mount” logic for `loadLanguage` (plus `loadedAppLangs` caching and retry-on-failure) isn’t covered by the existing `provider.test.tsx` cases. Please add tests asserting `loadLanguage` runs on mount for the initial language, is skipped when already loaded, and is retried after a failure (language removed from the set).

`useObjectLabel()` is invoked inside `try/catch` in `useGridFieldLabel()`, which violates `react-hooks/rules-of-hooks` (Hooks must not be called inside a `try` statement). Consider removing this wrapper and ensuring `useObjectLabel` itself is safe when i18n isn’t configured.

`useObjectLabel` creates new function instances every render (`resolve` and the returned label helpers). This makes downstream dependencies unstable (e.g., callers’ `useMemo`/`useCallback` will re-run every render). Memoize `resolve` with `useCallback` and return the helpers via `useMemo`/`useCallback` to keep references stable.

`setLanguage(currentLang)` won’t reliably “force re-render” here because React bails out when the next state equals the current value (and `language` is initialized from `i18nInstance.language`). If a re-render is needed after `addResourceBundle`, use a separate version/counter state or trigger an i18n event that `useTranslation` listens to (e.g., reload resources) instead of setting the same language value.
